name: System Monitor Pro
merging: Once published it cannot be taken back: from then on it is what people download.

steps: The zip is built once, and it must start and connect to a fake host on Windows and macOS
The tests run again on Windows, with no real sensors
`npm run measure` runs, on synthetic data
done: Tests, coverage and the security checks
The zip started and connected to a fake host on Windows and macOS

notes.install: Download `{zip}`, not the **Source code** archives, which will not start, and follow the [README]({blob}/README.md).
notes.about: Readings stay on this computer, and the plugin sends no telemetry. Processor and disk temperatures only come from the optional LibreHardwareMonitor, which loads a driver that some game anti-cheats block. Graphics card readings come from nvidia-smi and work with NVIDIA cards only. This project is not affiliated with Ulanzi, NVIDIA or LibreHardwareMonitor.
notes.checks: The automated checks passed on Windows, macOS and Linux, and found no known vulnerabilities in the dependencies and no secret patterns. These tools only find problems that are already known. This zip started on Windows and macOS against a fake host. No test ran against a real LibreHardwareMonitor, a real NVIDIA card or a real deck.
notes.measuredAgainst: a fake host, a fake LibreHardwareMonitor and a program standing in for nvidia-smi
